message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data before use in the dataset or training pipeline.

No detected untrusted source handling: The VGG16 model is loaded from a local file without checksum verification, and no remote source integrity checks (checksums, pinned commits, signed URLs) are present anywhere in the code.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no label distribution comparison, validation against an expected label set, or use of any label-noise detection tool anywhere in the code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code (InpaintDataset.py, transforms.py, misc.py) contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained weights via torch.load(args.load_G) and torch.load(args.load_D) and a VGG16 model from a local file without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates label distributions, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No neural-cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense is present in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: Standard Adam optimizers are used with no differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TF Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are referenced anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation from training, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on incoming data before it is passed to the model; inputs are used directly from the batch/dataset.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or bounds validation are applied to the model's output tensors before they are returned or logged.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an image inpainting model (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
